g.text: Documents are opened and rendered on your device. PrayDF only downloads a document you asked it to
The Windows app runs without administrator rights and registers itself only under HKEY_CURRENT_USER.
praydf: links are validated: only http(s) URLs and absolute local .pdf paths are accepted. Network
paths (\\server\share, file://host), other schemes, relative paths and control characters are
